=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text minus "-"
text found " found at index "
text nf " not found"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note returns the index of x in the sorted a, or -1; 16 elements need at most 5 halvings
fn bsearch a view long 16 x long to long
lo = ulong 0
hi = ulong 16
while lt lo hi bound 16
mid = add lo shr sub hi lo 1
v = get a mid
if eq v x
ret long mid
end
if lt v x
lo = add mid 1
else
hi = mid
end
end
ret -1
end
fn query a view long 16 x long to void
r = bsearch a x
emiti x
if ge r 0
emit found
emiti r
else
emit nf
end
emit nl
end
fn main to int
a = new long 16 0
put a 0 -40
put a 1 -12
put a 2 -3
put a 3 0
put a 4 2
put a 5 5
put a 6 8
put a 7 13
put a 8 21
put a 9 34
put a 10 55
put a 11 89
put a 12 144
put a 13 233
put a 14 377
put a 15 610
query a -40
query a 0
query a 21
query a 610
query a 7
query a 1000
query a -41
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
-40 found at index 0
0 found at index 3
21 found at index 8
610 found at index 15
7 not found
1000 not found
-41 not found
</pre>
